body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction would cause Damage to the target while it has at least one Core Wound. Response (unopposed): Reduce the Damage by 2, without changing existing Wounds.

surges.html: The target becomes Rallied until the start of your next turn.
Suppress one non-Critical Wound Condition's numerical penalties on the target until the start of your next turn.
